extracted.intended_audience: potential grantees, partners, community organizations, and the general public interested in CZI's work
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level organizational overview describing the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative's focus areas (science, education, community) and the ways it supports work (grants, ventures, local giving, capacity building). Useful as context for prospective partners or applicants seeking to align with CZI priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science focus — AI-powered biology / Biohub mission
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re leading the new era of AI-powered biology. At the Biohub, we bring together scientists, engineers, and AI experts with a shared mission to help scientists cure or prevent all disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes interdisciplinary teams (scientists, engineers, AI experts) and ambitious, disease-focused outcomes; implies preference for projects that leverage AI in biology and that contribute to curing or preventing disease.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education focus — bring learning science into classroom tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to bring learning science into the tools used every day by teachers and students, ensuring that technology reflects the realities of classrooms and strengthens teaching and learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes work that integrates learning science into practical education technology and that aligns with classroom realities; suggests preference for projects that strengthen teaching and learning through evidence-based tool design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants & Ventures investment posture
rubrics_metrics.description: Through grantmaking and our venture portfolio, we invest in bold ideas that have the potential to accelerate change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals preference for 'bold' and potentially transformative ideas; investments should align with CZI's values and demonstrate potential to accelerate systemic change. (Also notes historical scale: CZI has awarded ~ $7.22 billion in grants and invested nearly $300 million in ventures since 2015.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Local giving — community partnership and local solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Mark and Priscilla support the communities where they live and work by partnering with local nonprofits, supporting local solutions, and addressing emerging needs to help these communities thrive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates a preference for locally driven solutions, partnerships with local nonprofits, and responsiveness to emerging local needs; implies funding/support favoring community-rooted approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational and organizational channels for support
rubrics_metrics.description: CZI carries out its work through the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, LLC; the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Foundation (a 501(c)(3) private foundation); the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Donor-Advised Fund (DAF) at the Silicon Valley Community Foundation; and Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Advocacy, (a 501(c)(4) organization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the multiple legal/operational vehicles used to deliver funding and advocacy (grantmaking, venture investing, donor-advised funds, advocacy), implying that prospective partners should consider which vehicle best fits the type of support sought and any legal/eligibility constraints.
